components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commit action for save, continue, send, and unlock.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 17px; background: #1d1d1b; color: #fff; font: 610 14px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.16) inset, 0 10px 22px rgba(20,20,18,0.12); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0f0f0e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1d1b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action for history, reset, discard, and non-primary operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 12px; background: #fff; color: #55554f; font: 540 13px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f4f4f0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1d1b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.css: .ds-status-pill { min-height: 30px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; background: #fff; color: #55554f; font: 570 12.5px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-saved { background: #edf8f1; border-color: #cae5d4; color: #1f6b43; }

components.name: Mobile Card Row
components.description: Compact mobile edit row that opens a sheet or drawer.
components.css: .ds-mobile-row { width: 100%; min-height: 58px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #1d1d1b; text-align: left; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-row strong { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 610; } .ds-mobile-row em { display: block; color: #55554f; font-size: 13.5px; font-style: normal; } .ds-mobile-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1d1b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Prompt Field
components.description: Large editable instruction field for system prompts and version previews.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-prompt-field">You are the appointment-booking assistant for K1 Katsastus.</textarea>
components.css: .ds-prompt-field { width: 100%; min-height: 220px; border: 1px solid #d4d4cc; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #2d2d29; padding: 14px 16px; font: 400 14.5px/1.75 SFMono-Regular, SF Mono, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Menlo, monospace; resize: none; } .ds-prompt-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d1d1b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chat Bubble
components.description: Asymmetric message bubble for tester conversations.
components.html: Hi Bashir, this is K1 Katsastus. Your vehicle with registration ABC-123 is due for inspection soon. Would you like to book an appointment?
components.css: .ds-chat { width: fit-content; max-width: min(92%, 620px); padding: 13px 16px; border-radius: 17px; font: 400 15.5px/1.65 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-chat-agent { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; border-bottom-left-radius: 6px; color: #1d1d1b; } .ds-chat-user { background: #1d1d1b; color: #fff; border-bottom-right-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Configuration Tabs
components.description: Focused Chatbase-style section tabs for Prompt and Opening without broad product navigation.
components.css: .ds-config-tabs { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; border-radius: 12px; background: #efefea; } .ds-config-tabs button { min-height: 30px; padding: 0 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: #55554f; font: 570 13px/1.2 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-config-tabs button.active { color: #1d1d1b; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,18,.07); }

components.name: Live Tester Preview
components.description: Contained chat tester card centered on a faint dotted preview canvas.
components.css: .ds-preview { display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 28px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #deded8 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0 / 18px 18px, #f7f7f4; } .ds-tester-card { width: min(620px, 100%); min-height: 520px; border: 1px solid #e5e5df; border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(20,20,18,.10); }

narrative.overview: The interface is a quiet bench for configuring one existing agent, not a campaign page or a general AI lab. It blends OpenAI Platform's restrained product-console typography and density with Chatbase's focused settings column, tabbed configuration, sticky save decisions, and live chat preview on a dotted canvas. The visual system is restrained and operational: off-white canvas, white work surfaces, thin neutral rules, near-black primary actions, and state color only where it changes the user's decision. Motion is used to clarify state changes such as drawers, sheets, saved banners, locks, and new chat messages.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, low-contrast workspace with high-contrast actions.
Focused enough for one existing agent; no broad product navigation.
Dense enough for prompt work, never card-stacked for decoration.
State-first language: saved, draft, locked, restored, active.
Mobile interactions use sheets and bottom navigation instead of shrinking desktop panes.

rules.name: The Rare Action Rule
rules.body: Near-black is reserved for the action that commits or sends. Secondary actions stay on paper with a rule.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red only describe real status or recovery. They are not decorative accents.

rules.name: The Prompt Legibility Rule
rules.body: Prompt text gets larger line height and a monospaced face; it is edited like instructions, not scanned like marketing copy.

rules.name: The Split-Then-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Desktop keeps edit and test visible together; mobile uses one focused task surface at a time.

dos: Do keep the user's current state visible: saved, draft, active version, or locked.
Do keep desktop editing and testing adjacent unless the configuration is locked.
Do use sheets/drawers for mobile details rather than dense desktop controls.
Do reserve semantic color for actual save, draft, error, and locked states.
Do use the prompt type treatment for long editable agent instructions.
donts: Don't introduce new-agent creation, workflow-building, or broad AI-platform navigation.
Don't use decorative color, gradient text, emoji icons, or generic AI-themed ornament.
Don't make locked state visually similar to editable state.
Don't bury version restore behind a hidden desktop-only control.
